fixture.provenance: Manual component-rule arithmetic; not an external golden

rulebook.region: North Indian eight-component framework; explicit composite tables, not a canonical school
rulebook.exceptionPolicy: raw scores only; no cancellation or adjusted total
rulebook.vashyaVariant: four-class full-sign table published by Telugu Calendar; no 15-degree splits
rulebook.yoniVariant: Raman Muhurtha table 2 as printed; two asymmetric pairs retained, animal symbols only

components.definition: 1 if chart-group index A >= B, else 0; no identity or human rank inferred
Four full-sign classes; B row, A column. Half-sign variants are not applied.
Inclusive cyclic counts reduced to 1..9; each direction outside 3/5/7 earns 1.5.
Printed Raman table 2, B row/A column; asymmetric horse/hare and buffalo/lion cells retained.
Moon-sign lords, natural-friendship point table; temporary friendship excluded.
Directional lookup: B row, A column. Symbol names do not classify personality.
0 for relative sign pairs 2/12, 5/9 or 6/8; otherwise 7. No cancellation.
Same symbolic group 0, different group 8. No health, hereditary or fertility inference.

result.precision: nominal-longitude-input; caller must enforce birth admission

fixture.provenance: Primary Prokerala sample: groom Magha/Leo, bride Ashwini/Aries; selected lunar-class interiors, not reconstructed birth ephemerides
fixture.difference: Only Vashya differs: selected four-class table gives 2 for two quadruped signs; publisher separates Leo and gives 0. Never claim whole-report agreement.
